Name: LOCK_CAM_PARAM_ST
Description: Determines the parameters relating to lock-on camera configurations, and the default camera.

Fields.Name: Camera: Target Distance
Fields.Description: Distance from the camera to the character, in metres.

Fields.Name: Rotation: Minimum X-Axis Value
Fields.Description: The minimum rotational value on the X-axis for the camera. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Lock-on - Rotation: Shift Ratio
Fields.Description: Base vertical screen position of the lock-on target (-1.0 to 1.0). 0.0: the target is at the centre of the screen, 1.0: at the top, -1.0: at the bottom.

Fields.Name: Character: Height Offset (Ground)
Fields.Description: The height of the camera's look point (from the character's root position, when touching the ground). In metres.

Fields.Name: Character: Max Lock Radius
Fields.Description: Maximum lock-on range around the character, in metres.

Fields.Name: Camera: Vertical Field of View
Fields.Description: Vertical field of view of the camera, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Character: Horizontal Tracking %
Fields.Description: The character tracking rate for left and right motion, applied to the camera.

Fields.Name: Character: Up Tracking %
Fields.Description: The character tracking rate for upward motion, applied to the camera (0.0-1.0).

Fields.Name: Character: Forward Tracking %
Fields.Description: The character tracking rate for forward motion, applied to the camera.

Fields.Name: Character: Backward Tracking %
Fields.Description: The character tracking rate for backward motion, applied to the camera.

Fields.Name: Lock-on - Rotation: Interpolation for Shift Ratio
Fields.Description: Interpolation rate (0.0-1.0) applied to the lock-on shift ratio, independent of distance.

Fields.Name: Over-the-Shoulder: Angle
Fields.Description: If not 0, then an over-the-shoulder perspective is applied. If positive, the character is to the left, if negative, to the right.

Fields.Name: Lock-on - Interpolation %
Fields.Description: The interpolation rate for the lock-camera parameters.

Fields.Name: Over-the-Shoulder: Turning Method
Fields.Description: How the over-the-shoulder side is switched. Marked as a test setting slated for removal.

Fields.Name: Over-the-Shoulder: Turning Speed
Fields.Description: For the 'Press and Hold (Angle)' turning method: speed at which the view changes (0.0-1.0). 0: the view doesn't change.

Fields.Name: Over-the-Shoulder: Turning Time Threshold
Fields.Description: For the 'Press and Hold (Time)' turning method: time before the view switches, in seconds.

Fields.Name: Over-the-Shoulder: Turning Interpolation %
Fields.Description: Interpolation rate (0.0-1.0) used when the over-the-shoulder view turns, for all turning methods. Needs careful tuning to avoid motion sickness.

Fields.Name: Character: Horizontal Tracking Acceleration
Fields.Description: Horizontal acceleration at or above which the horizontal tracking rate is at its lowest. In metres per second squared.

Fields.Name: Character: Maximum Horizontal Tracking Reduction from Acceleration
Fields.Description: While the character accelerates sideways the horizontal tracking rate drops, to give a sense of acceleration. This is the largest reduction.

Fields.Name: Character: Horizontal Tracking Interpolation %
Fields.Description: Interpolation rate (0.0-1.0) of the horizontal tracking rate. Only applied while the tracking rate rises.

Fields.Name: Over-the-Shoulder: Turning Time Threshold (Short Flick)
Fields.Description: For the short flick turning method: time threshold for switching the view, in seconds. Values of 1 frame or less have undefined behaviour.

Fields.Name: Character: Vertical Tracking Acceleration
Fields.Description: Vertical acceleration at or above which the vertical tracking rate is at its lowest. In metres per second squared.

Fields.Name: Character: Maximum Vertical Tracking Reduction from Acceleration
Fields.Description: While the character accelerates vertically the vertical tracking rate drops, to give a sense of acceleration. This is the largest reduction.

Fields.Name: Character: Vertical Tracking Interpolation %
Fields.Description: Interpolation rate (0.0-1.0) of the vertical tracking rate. Only applied while the tracking rate rises.

Fields.Name: Over-the-Shoulder: Minimum Rotation Input Threshold (Short Flick)
Fields.Description: For the short flick turning method: the view only switches when the stick is pushed at least this far, to ignore accidental touches. In radians.

Fields.Name: Lock-on - Rotation Tracking %
Fields.Description: Tracking rate (0.0-1.0) when turning the camera towards the locked-on target.

Fields.Name: Rotation Speed: Minimum (X-Axis)
Fields.Description: The minimum rotation speed on the X-axis. In degrees per second.

Fields.Name: Rotation Speed: Maximum (X-Axis)
Fields.Description: The maximum rotation speed on the X-axis. In degrees per second.

Fields.Name: Rotation High Speed: Minimum (X-Axis)
Fields.Description: The minimum rotation speed on the X-axis in the high-speed state. In degrees per second.

Fields.Name: Rotation High Speed: Maximum (X-Axis)
Fields.Description: The maximum rotation speed on the X-axis in the high-speed state. In degrees per second.

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: The priority at which this parameter is applied. If the priority is the same as another, the ordering is handled internally.

Fields.Name: Over-the-Shoulder: Reverse Direction of Rotation
Fields.Description: If ON, when the character is on the left-hand side of the screen, and turns to the right, the over-the-shoulder perspective will switch, and vice versa.

Fields.Name: Over-the-Shoulder: Apply when Locked
Fields.Description: If ON, then the over-the-shoulder perspective will apply whilst locked-on.

Fields.Name: Over-the-Shoulder: Apply when Unlocked
Fields.Description: If ON, then the over-the-shoulder perspective will apply whilst not locked-on.

Fields.Name: Ignore Options Rotation Speed %
Fields.Description: If ON, the camera rotation speed set in the options is ignored and treated as 5.

Fields.Name: Lock-on - Reticule Lead Factor
Fields.Description: How quickly the lock reticule moves ahead of the target: a factor applied to the movement speed.

Fields.Name: Rotation: Maximum X-Axis Value
Fields.Description: The maximum rotational value on the X-axis for the camera. In degrees. Used for camera control in the shooting stance.

Fields.Name: Rotation: Minimum Y-Axis Value
Fields.Description: The minimum rotational value on the Y-axis for the camera. In degrees. Used for camera control in the shooting stance.

Fields.Name: Rotation: Maximum Y-Axis Value
Fields.Description: The maximum rotational value on the Y-axis for the camera. In degrees. Used for camera control in the shooting stance.

Fields.Name: Character: Down Tracking %
Fields.Description: The character tracking rate for down motion, applied to the camera.

Fields.Name: Lock-on - Rotation: Minimum Shift Ratio
Fields.Description: Lowest vertical screen position of the lock-on target (-1.0 to 1.0), used at long range. 0.0: centre of the screen, 1.0: top, -1.0: bottom.

Fields.Name: Lock-on - Rotation: Maximum Shift Ratio
Fields.Description: Highest vertical screen position of the lock-on target (-1.0 to 1.0), used at close range. 0.0: centre of the screen, 1.0: top, -1.0: bottom.

Fields.Name: Lock-on - Rotation: Shift Ratio - Interpolation Minimum Distance
Fields.Description: Within this distance to the target the shift ratio is at its maximum; beyond it the ratio is interpolated.

Fields.Name: Lock-on - Rotation: Shift Ratio - Interpolation Middle-Minimum Distance
Fields.Description: Beyond this distance to the target the shift ratio is at its base value; closer in it is interpolated towards the maximum.

Fields.Name: Lock-on - Rotation: Shift Ratio - Interpolation Middle-Maximum Distance
Fields.Description: Within this distance to the target the shift ratio is at its base value; further out it is interpolated towards the minimum.

Fields.Name: Lock-on - Rotation: Shift Ratio - Interpolation Maximum Distance
Fields.Description: Beyond this distance to the target the shift ratio is at its minimum; within it the ratio is interpolated.

Fields.Name: Character: Maximum Horizontal Tracking Reduction from Speed
Fields.Description: The largest reduction of the horizontal tracking rate caused by the character's sideways speed. Gives a sense of speed during Quick Boost and boosting.

Fields.Name: Character: Horizontal Speed for Lowest Tracking
Fields.Description: Horizontal speed at which the horizontal tracking rate is lowest, in metres per second. Below it, the tracking reduction scales linearly with speed.

Fields.Name: Character: Maximum Forward Tracking Reduction from Speed
Fields.Description: The largest reduction of the forward tracking rate caused by the character's forward speed. Gives a sense of speed during Quick Boost and boosting.

Fields.Name: Character: Maximum Backward Tracking Reduction from Speed
Fields.Description: The largest reduction of the backward tracking rate caused by the character's backward speed. Gives a sense of speed during Quick Boost and boosting.

Fields.Name: Camera: Too Close to Target Distance
Fields.Description: When the player is within this distance of the lock-on target, special handling is applied to the over-the-shoulder angle and the camera's X rotation. In metres.

Fields.Name: Over-the-Shoulder: Interpolation %
Fields.Description: Interpolation rate (0.0-1.0) of the over-the-shoulder angle, independent of the parameter interpolation rate.

Fields.Name: Over-the-Shoulder: Interpolation % (Lock-on Toggle)
Fields.Description: Interpolation rate (0.0-1.0) of the over-the-shoulder angle when lock-on is switched on or off.

Fields.Name: Over-the-Shoulder: Interpolation of Interpolation %
Fields.Description: Interpolation rate (0.0-1.0) applied to the over-the-shoulder interpolation rate itself, so that it doesn't change abruptly.

Fields.Name: Quick Boost: Horizontal Tracking %
Fields.Description: The horizontal tracking rate during quick-boost of characters.

Fields.Name: Quick Boost: Forward Tracking %
Fields.Description: The forward tracking rate during quick-boost of characters.

Fields.Name: Quick Boost: Backward Tracking %
Fields.Description: The backward tracking rate during quick-boost of characters.

Fields.Name: Boost: Horizontal Tracking %
Fields.Description: The horizontal character tracking rate while boosting (0.0-1.0).

Fields.Name: Boost: Forward Tracking %
Fields.Description: The forward character tracking rate while boosting (0.0-1.0).

Fields.Name: Boost: Backward Tracking %
Fields.Description: The backward character tracking rate while boosting (0.0-1.0).

Fields.Name: Character: Forward Tracking Interpolation %
Fields.Description: Interpolation rate (0.0-1.0) of the forward tracking rate. Only applied while the tracking rate rises.

Fields.Name: Character: Backward Tracking Interpolation %
Fields.Description: Interpolation rate (0.0-1.0) of the backward tracking rate. Only applied while the tracking rate rises.

Fields.Name: Shoot Target: Look-Down Angle (Unlocked)
Fields.Description: Angle the camera tilts down while it is a free camera (when not locked on and under player control). In degrees.

Fields.Name: Shoot Target: Look-Down Angle (Locked)
Fields.Description: Angle the camera tilts down while locked on. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Lock-on - Rotation: Horizontal Play Angle
Fields.Description: Horizontal play (slack) angle for the lock-on target, in degrees: how far the target may drift from the screen centre before the camera follows.

Fields.Name: Camera Look: Height Correction (Up)
Fields.Description: The offset to apply to the upwards camera look on the Y-axis. In metres.

Fields.Name: Camera Look: Depth Correction (Up)
Fields.Description: The offset to apply to the upwards camera look on the Z-axis. In metres.

Fields.Name: Camera Look: Height Correction (Down)
Fields.Description: The offset to apply to the downwards camera look on the Y-axis. In metres.

Fields.Name: Camera Look: Depth Correction (Down)
Fields.Description: The offset to apply to the downwards camera look on the Z-axis. In metres.

Fields.Name: Lock-on Target: Rotation Speed (Passing)
Fields.Description: Recovery rate (0.0-1.0) of the lock rotation tracking after passing the target. The higher the value, the faster the camera turns back to the target.

Fields.Name: Lock-on Target: Rotation Tracking % (Passing)
Fields.Description: Lock rotation tracking rate (0.0-1.0) applied while the passing effect lasts. The smaller the value, the straighter the player's movement.

Fields.Name: Passing Effect Duration
Fields.Description: How long the passing effect lasts, in seconds.

Fields.Name: Horizontal Distance Threshold for Passing
Fields.Description: Passing can only occur when the horizontal distance between the player and the lock-on target is at or above this value. In metres.

Fields.Name: Relative Velocity Threshold for Passing
Fields.Description: Passing can only occur when the horizontal relative speed between the player and the lock-on target is at or above this value. In metres per second.

Fields.Name: Lock-on - Rotation: Vertical Play Angle
Fields.Description: Vertical play (slack) angle for the lock-on target, in degrees: how far the target may drift from the screen centre before the camera follows.

Fields.Name: Lock-on - Rotation: Horizontal Return Interpolation %
Fields.Description: Interpolation rate (0.0-1.0) as the lock-on target gradually returns from the horizontal play angle to the centre of the screen.

Fields.Name: Lock-on - Rotation: Vertical Return Interpolation %
Fields.Description: Interpolation rate (0.0-1.0) as the lock-on target gradually returns from the vertical play angle to the centre of the screen.

Fields.Name: Automatic Camera Pull: X-Axis Rotation Threshold
Fields.Description: Applies when the camera looks up. The angle on the X-axis at which the threshold for the automatic camera pulling occurs. -1 means it will trigger if the camera descends to the character's root position. Set to 90 to disable the pulling.

Fields.Name: Automatic Camera Pull: Weight
Fields.Description: Applies when the camera looks up. Weight (0.0-1.0) of the automatic pull: higher values lower the camera's rotation so the player's feet stay in view; lower values keep the whole enemy in view.

Fields.Name: Automatic Camera Pull: Distance Multiplier
Fields.Description: Applies when the camera looks up. Multiplier for the automatic pull-back distance; higher values pull the camera further back.

Fields.Name: Automatic Camera Pull: Maximum Distance
Fields.Description: Applies when the camera looks up. The maximum distance of the automatic pull-back, in metres.

Fields.Name: Character: Height Offset (Ascending)
Fields.Description: The height of the camera's look point (from the character's root position, whilst ascending). In metres.

Fields.Name: Character: Height Offset (Descending)
Fields.Description: The height of the camera's look point (from the character's root position, whilst descending). In metres.

Fields.Name: Character: Height Offset Interpolation %
Fields.Description: The interpolation rate for the character height offset.

Fields.Name: Character: Height Offset Interpolation % (Disable Camera Aerial Offset)
Fields.Description: The interpolation rate for the character height offset, after the 'Disable camera aerial offset (for PC)' event has been triggered via TAE.

Fields.Name: Character: Dither Fade Distance
Fields.Description: Distance between the camera and the player character below which the dither fade is applied.

Fields.Name: Rotation Speed: Minimum (Y-Axis)
Fields.Description: The minimum rotation speed on the Y-axis. In degrees per second.

Fields.Name: Rotation Speed: Maximum (Y-Axis)
Fields.Description: The maximum rotation speed on the Y-axis. In degrees per second.

Fields.Name: Rotation High Speed: Minimum (Y-Axis)
Fields.Description: The minimum rotation speed on the Y-axis in the high-speed state. In degrees per second.

Fields.Name: Rotation High Speed: Maximum (Y-Axis)
Fields.Description: The maximum rotation speed on the Y-axis in the high-speed state. In degrees per second.
